Primary button + "Still needed: …" module (ready line)

Source: R/modules.R
kit_run_gate_ui.Rd

The primary button is shown (disabled) from the start; it can be pressed only when nothing is still needed (missing() is empty). Above it, a bold line says "還差：…" ("Still needed: …"), followed by a link to where to fix it. The reactive returned by the server changes only when the button is pressed while nothing is still needed (the server also blocks it, not just the disabled button), so a plain observeEvent(run(), …) is enough.

Usage

kit_run_gate_ui(id, label, ...)

kit_run_gate_server(id, missing, link = function() NULL)

Arguments

id

The module id.

label

The primary button's text (start with a verb, for example "執行串接", "Run join").

...

Other arguments passed to kit_button().

missing

A reactive: what is still needed (character vector; length 0 = ready to run).

link

A function: the link after "還差" ("Still needed") (a tag or NULL).

Value

kit_run_gate_ui(): the slot for the "還差" line and the primary button.

kit_run_gate_server(): a reactive counting presses made while ready to run (0 at first).

See also

kit_ready_line(), kit_run_gate() (low-level)

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  ui <- kit_page("KIT 示範", NULL,
    shiny::selectInput("id_col", "ID 欄", c("", "subj_id")),
    kit_run_gate_ui("run", "執行串接")
  )
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    run <- kit_run_gate_server("run", shiny::reactive(if (input$id_col == "") "選 ID 欄"))
    shiny::observeEvent(run(), message("執行"), ignoreInit = TRUE)
  }
  shiny::shinyApp(ui, server)
}
